messages.action_stop: Stop the ringing alarm or timer
messages.action_time_left: Say the time left on your timers
messages.rb_passed_today: Today's has already passed, so it's tomorrow.
messages.rb_conflict: You said more than one date or time; I used the first.
messages.err_no_time: At what time? Say the alarm with its time, for example "alarm tomorrow at 7 AM".
messages.err_no_time_heard: I got {heard}, but not the time. Say it with the time, for example "alarm tomorrow at 7 AM".
messages.err_bad_date: That date doesn't exist. Check the day and the month.
messages.err_bad_time: That time doesn't exist. Check the hour and the minutes.
messages.err_bad_repeat: An alarm can repeat at most once a day, for example "every day".
messages.err_in_past: That time has already passed. Say another time.
messages.err_passed_now: That time has passed in the meantime. Say the alarm again.
messages.err_full: You have too many alarms and timers. Remove some in Preferences, Timer & Alarm.
messages.err_timer_too_long: A timer can run for 24 hours at most. For longer, set an alarm.
messages.err_timer_clock: For a time of day, set an alarm, for example "alarm tomorrow at 5 AM". A timer needs a length, such as "timer 10 minutes".
messages.no_alarms: You have no alarms. For example, say "alarm tomorrow at 6 AM".
messages.timer_not_found: I can't find a timer called "{name}".
messages.alarm_not_found: I can't find an alarm called "{name}".
messages.item_not_found: I can't find an alarm or timer called "{name}".
messages.which_timer: Your timers: {items}. Say which one, for example "cancel the {example} timer".
messages.which_alarm: Your alarms: {items}. Say which one to delete, for example "delete the {example} alarm".
messages.nothing_ringing: Nothing is ringing. To cancel a timer, say "cancel the timer".
messages.closed_alarm: While Hariku was closed, {name} was due at {at}.
messages.closed_timer: While Hariku was closed, {name} finished at {at}.
messages.list_empty: You have no alarms or timers. For example, say "alarm tomorrow at 6 AM" or "timer 10 minutes".
messages.lbl_ring: Ring for (then it counts as missed):
messages.about_text: Open Aruna (Ctrl+Alt+Backspace) and type or say, in English or Indonesian: "alarm tomorrow at 6 AM", "set alarm tomorrow at 2 for the match", "wake me up at 5", "alarm every day at 5 AM for the morning walk". Aruna reads the alarm back with its day, date and time (AM or PM) and sets it when you say yes; if the time is wrong, say it again, for example "at 2 PM". Timers start at once: "timer 10 minutes", "tea timer 3 minutes", "set a timer for an hour and a half". Also: "cancel the tea timer", "how long is left", "list my alarms". When one rings, press any key to stop it, or tell Aruna "stop" or "snooze" ("snooze 10 minutes"). It rings even when Hariku is in the tray and during quiet hours. Everything stays on your computer.
